name: claude-coach
description: Coaching for Claude Code: a coach for your commands, and a drill master for your DevOps way of working.

plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: A coach for your Claude Code commands: captures corrections from a session and applies them back to the command.

plugins.name: devops-drillmaster
plugins.description: A drill sergeant for your agile setup with Claude: sets up processes and policies around your objective and toolchain, keeps an impediment log on every work item, and runs retrospectives that change the process one experiment at a time.
